messages:
julia: Hey team — small hotfix PR ready, need quick approvals before today's freeze window. PR: #10458. Fixes a nil deref in streaming router that causes ~1% 5xxs.

max: can you paste the failing test from CI?

julia: CI is flaky right now — only failing integration `streaming-kv-test` on p99 env. Here's the failing log excerpt:
```
E 2026-03-17T14:02:11Z stream_router.go:243 nil pointer deref
goroutine 123 [running]:
... (truncated)
```

sam: i can rerun the integration job if you push a small tweak or rebase. when is the freeze cutoff? iirc 16:00 UTC?

release-bot: Reminder: deploy freeze starts at 2026-03-17T16:00:00Z. Merges allowed into the queue until 2026-03-17T15:30:00Z for last-minute patches. After that only emergency fixes with PM/Eng lead sign-off.

julia: thanks — i'll squash the debug commit and push. want to keep the commit message as `router: guard against nil in stream handler`.

lina: skimmed the diff — looks tiny. left one inline comment about returning early vs panic. otherwise LGTM. can you squash into one commit and i'll approve.

kevin: i'll give an approval once ci passes. if sam can rerun the integration that would help.

sam: kicked rerun for `eng-integ/streaming-kv` (build id 987654). ci-bot will post updates.

ci-bot: Build 987654 queued -> running -> failing
ci-bot: Rerun requested by sam: Build 987655 queued
ci-bot: Build 987655 passed ✅

kevin: approved ✅

lina: approved ✅

julia: thanks all — squashed and force-pushed. triggering merge queue.

release-bot: Merge queue accepted PR #10458. Estimated landing before freeze cutoff.

julia: landed via merge queue. thanks for quick reviews :party_parrot:

max: awesome, nice catch.

sam: nice teamwork. tagging incident if it reappears.

julia: noted — will follow up with small smoke test in staging and add a regression test.
